articles.headline: Governor announces construction of new international airport in Lagos
articles.body: LAGOS — The Lagos State Governor has announced the construction of a new international airport in Lagos. The airport, to be sited on the Lekki-Epe corridor, will create thousands of jobs and boost trade and tourism, officials said at a briefing. Details of the project were shared with reporters on Saturday.
